title: Canonical switch endpoint correction
problem: The phase-56 edge-flush experiment used 24px horizontal travel with zero horizontal containment, which visibly pushed the thumb against the pill boundary and left the source with duplicated/contradictory switch CSS. Disabled switches could also look optically centered instead of seated at the OFF endpoint.

resolution.disabled_geometry: identical to enabled geometry; appearance only changes
resolution.setup_reinstall: root and platform setup scripts force-reinstall the bundled wheel so same-version hotfixes cannot be skipped

scope: Golden Company UI switch implementation and its validation/setup paths only. No DataTable, chart, navigation, workspace, runtime, or application-specific behavior changed.
